result:
Looking at the qlang documentation, I'll construct queries for each task, working through the syntax and semantics carefully.

Key patterns I've learned:
- `|` chains steps left-to-right
- `*` maps over vector/map elements (keeping keys for maps)
- `filter ~(...)` takes a quote with a boolean predicate
- `/key` reads map/array elements; `/0`, `/1`, etc. for array indices
- `groupBy ~/expr` groups by the result of a modifier applied to each element
- `entries` converts a map to [key, value] pairs

Let me work through each task:

N1: Extract domain (after @) from valid emails, lowercase, deduplicate, sort
N2: Filter paid orders (case-insensitive), compute amount per line, group by customer, top 2
N3: Filter open issues, extract assignee login (or "unassigned"), count per assignee
N4: Combine dependencies maps, filter by ^-pinned versions, extract names, sort
N5: Filter enabled services, count them, collect distinct ports (sorted), sum replicas (null→1)
N6: Filter ERROR lines, extract service from [service] format, count per service, top 2
N7: Parse CSV, skip empty qty/price, group by region (lowercase), sum revenue per region
N8: Group by user, filter to those with "login" event (case-insensitive) but no "logout"
N9: Filter non-null salaries, group by dept, compute average rounded to 1 decimal
N10: Parse lines, extract tags after colon, split by comma, trim and lowercase, deduplicate, sort
N11: Lowercase words, group, filter >1 occurrence, format with count, sort by count then word
N12: Filter non-draft/non-prerelease, sum download_count per asset, top 3 by downloads
N13: Filter tools category (case-insensitive), count, check all priced, collect in-stock names
N14: Parse pip requirements, remove comments/options/non-pinned, map name→version

N1: /data/users | filter ~((/active | eq true) and (/email | ne null)) | * (/email | split "@" | last | lower) | distinct | sort

N2: filter ~((/status | lower | eq "paid")) | * {:customer (/customer/name) :amount (/lines | * (mul /qty /unit_price) | sum | sub (/discount | coalesce 0))} | groupBy ~/customer | entries | * {:customer /0 :total (/1 | * /amount | sum)} | sort ~((/total | desc)) | take 2 | * {:customer /customer :total (/total | round 2)}

N3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :assignee | at /login | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy ~(/) | * count

N4: /dependencies | coalesce {} | union (/devDependencies | coalesce {}) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * /0 | sort

N5: /services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) | {:enabledCount (count) :ports (* /port | vals | filter ~(ne null) | distinct | sort) :totalReplicas (* (/replicas | coalesce 1) | vals | sum)}

N6: lines | filter ~(contains " ERROR ") | * (split "[" | /1 | split "]" | /0) | groupBy ~(/) | * count | entries | sort ~([(/1 | desc) /0]) | take 2 | * {:service /0 :count /1}

N7: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~((/2 | ne "") and (/3 | ne "")) | * {:region (/0 | lower) :revenue (mul /2 /3)} | groupBy ~/region | * (. * /revenue | sum | round 2)

N8: groupBy ~/user | entries | filter ~((/1 * (/type | lower | eq "login") | any) and ((/1 * (/type | lower | eq "logout") | any) | not)) | * /0 | sort

N9: filter ~(/salary | ne null) | groupBy ~/dept | * (:employees / | :sum (employees | * /salary | sum) | sum | div (employees | count) | round 1)

N10: lines | filter ~(ne "") | * (split ":" | /1 | split "," | * (lower | trim)) | flat | distinct | sort

N11: ["Apple", "banana", "apple", "Cherry", "BANANA", "apple", "date"] | * lower | groupBy ~(/) | entries | filter ~(/1 | count | gt 1) | * {:word /0 :count (/1 | count)} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /word])

N12: /releases | filter ~((at :draft | ne true) and (at :prerelease | ne true)) | * {:tag /tag_name :downloads (at :assets | coalesce [] | * (/download_count | coalesce 0) | sum)} | sort ~(/downloads | desc) | take 3

N13: filter ~(/category | lower | eq "tools") | {:count (count) :allPriced (. * (/price | ne null | and (/price | gt 0)) | every) :inStockNames (. * (if (/stock | gt 0) /name null) | filter ~(ne null) | sort)}

N14: lines | filter ~(ne "") | * (split "#" | /0 | trim) | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "-" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "==" | {(/0 | trim | lower) (/1 | trim)}) | reduce {} ~(union .)
